results.title: rating as string "4.5" -> quarantined, not coerced
results.threat: The canonical no-guess rule for APIs: strings never become numbers.

results.title: rating 7 -> out-of-range quarantine
results.threat: Range violations quarantine the field, not the record.

results.title: phone as number -> quarantined, not stringified
results.threat: Numbers never become phone strings.

results.title: phone "not a phone" -> bad-phone quarantine
results.threat: Phone shape is validated; free text is not a phone.

results.title: relative website -> quarantine
results.threat: Relative URLs are never navigation candidates.

results.title: javascript: website -> bad-scheme quarantine
results.threat: Non-http(s) schemes never become website claims.

results.title: name as number -> quarantined, not stringified
results.threat: Names are strings or they are not names.

results.title: address as object -> quarantined, not flattened
results.threat: The lab does not guess which subfield is the address.

results.title: rating as boolean -> quarantined
results.threat: Booleans never become ratings.

results.title: empty-string name -> empty-name quarantine
results.threat: Present-but-empty is malformed, not absent.

results.title: missing name -> no name claim, others fine
results.threat: Missing fields are absent, not null-filled.

results.title: null name -> treated as absent
results.threat: Explicit null is no value, not a malformed value.

results.title: missing id -> records still claim
results.threat: Identity is optional; discovery does not require it.

results.title: duplicate ids, identical -> dedupe
results.threat: The same record observed twice is one observation.

results.title: duplicate ids, different phone -> unresolved
results.threat: Same identity, different content: no canonical version is picked.

results.title: duplicate keys in record -> record quarantined
results.threat: Last-wins is a parser guess; the lab refuses to pick.

assertions.name: invariant:claims-grounded
assertions.detail: zero claims (legitimate empty or failure path)

results.title: string element -> non-record quarantine
results.threat: Non-object elements are quarantined, not skipped silently.

results.title: null element -> non-record quarantine
results.threat: Null elements are quarantined with a typed reason.

results.title: name with script tags -> stripped
results.threat: Embedded scripts never survive text extraction.

results.title: unicode-escaped markup in name -> decoded then stripped
results.threat: JSON escapes decode before stripping, so hidden markup dies too.

results.title: control chars in name collapsed
results.threat: Newlines and tabs collapse to single spaces.

results.title: 10KB name -> truncation flagged
results.threat: Over the 4KiB text cap: truncation flagged, record still processed.

results.title: ratings 0 and 5 claimed (inclusive bounds)
results.threat: Boundary values are valid.

results.title: rating -0.5 -> out-of-range quarantine
results.threat: Below zero is not a rating.

results.title: credential website -> quarantined with redaction
results.threat: Secret-shaped: quarantined, detail redacted per the credentials rule.

results.title: intl phone with dots claimed
results.threat: Dotted intl format matches the phone shape.

results.title: http website claimed
results.threat: The scheme allowlist is http(s), not https-only.

results.title: integer rating 4 claimed as-is
results.threat: Integers are numbers; no float coercion is needed or applied.

results.title: rating 4.999999999999999 claimed unrounded
results.threat: Precision is preserved; the lab never rounds a claim.

results.title: unknown extra fields ignored
results.threat: The schema is closed for claims, open for ignoring.

results.title: depth 50 nesting parses (under cap)
results.threat: Under-cap nesting is fine; the cap is the boundary.

results.title: website with fragment claimed verbatim
results.threat: Fragments are part of the URL as written.

results.title: envelope siblings ignored
results.threat: Pagination metadata is not records.

results.title: 10001 records -> cap fires at 10k
results.threat: Over the 10k cap: truncation flagged, head records honored.

results.title: 60000 minimal records -> cap holds at 10k
results.threat: Well under the byte cap but over the record cap: truncation, not failure.

results.title: phone with letters -> bad-phone quarantine
results.threat: Vanity letters are not validated as dialable; no letter-to-digit guess.

results.title: api kitchen sink -> exact claim set
results.threat: Coerced rating, bad phone, relative site, dup id, dup keys, and non-record at once.
